title: Josh Tarling to Return to Racing Eight Days After Brother Finlay Killed By Driver at Volta a Portugal
content:
Netcompany Ineos 'fully supports' Josh Tarling in his return to racing at Vuelta a España as officials open investigation into his younger brother Finlay's tragic death.

Read the full article at Josh Tarling to Return to Racing Eight Days After Brother Finlay Killed By Driver at Volta a Portugal on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
